vulg: Paulus apostolus Christi Iesu secundum imperium Dei salvatoris nostri et Christi Iesu spei nostrae
clem: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi secundum imperium Dei Salvatoris nostri, et Christi Jesu spei nostr,
tr: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου κατ επιταγην θεου σωτηρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου της ελπιδος ημων
kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

vulg: Timotheo dilecto filio in fide gratia misericordia pax a Deo Patre et Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: Timotheo dilecto filio in fide. Gratia, misericordia, et pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: τιμοθεω γνησιω τεκνω εν πιστει χαρις ελεος ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και χριστου ιησου  ιησου χριστου  του κυριου ημων
kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

vulg: sicut rogavi te ut remaneres Ephesi cum irem in Macedoniam ut denuntiares quibusdam ne aliter docerent
clem: Sicut rogavi te ut remaneres Ephesi cum irem in Macedoniam, ut denuntiares quibusdam ne aliter docerent,
tr: καθως παρεκαλεσα σε προσμειναι εν εφεσω πορευομενος εις μακεδονιαν ινα παραγγειλης τισιν μη ετεροδιδασκαλειν
kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

vulg: neque intenderent fabulis et genealogiis interminatis quae quaestiones praestant magis quam aedificationem Dei quae est in fide
clem: neque intenderent fabulis, et genealogiis interminatis: qu qustiones prstant magis quam dificationem Dei, qu est in fide.
tr: μηδε προσεχειν μυθοις και γενεαλογιαις απεραντοις αιτινες ζητησεις παρεχουσιν μαλλον η οικονομιαν  οικοδομιαν  θεου την εν πιστει
kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

vulg: finis autem praecepti est caritas de corde puro et conscientia bona et fide non ficta
clem: Finis autem prcepti est caritas de corde puro, et conscientia bona, et fide non ficta.
tr: το δε τελος της παραγγελιας εστιν αγαπη εκ καθαρας καρδιας και συνειδησεως αγαθης και πιστεως ανυποκριτου
kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

vulg: a quibus quidam aberrantes conversi sunt in vaniloquium
clem: A quibus quidam aberrantes, conversi sunt in vaniloquium,
tr: ων τινες αστοχησαντες εξετραπησαν εις ματαιολογιαν
kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

vulg: volentes esse legis doctores non intellegentes neque quae loquuntur neque de quibus adfirmant
clem: volentes esse legis doctores, non intelligentes neque qu loquuntur, neque de quibus affirmant.
tr: θελοντες ειναι νομοδιδασκαλοι μη νοουντες μητε α λεγουσιν μητε περι τινων διαβεβαιουνται
kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

vulg: scimus autem quia bona est lex si quis ea legitime utatur
clem: Scimus autem quia bona est lex si quis ex legitime utatur:
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι καλος ο νομος εαν τις αυτω νομιμως χρηται
kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

vulg: sciens hoc quia iusto lex non est posita sed iniustis et non subditis impiis et peccatoribus sceleratis et contaminatis patricidis et matricidis homicidis
clem: sciens hoc quia lex justo non est posita, sed injustis, et non subditis, impiis, et peccatoribus, sceleratis, et contaminatis, parricidis, et matricidis, homicidis,
tr: ειδως τουτο οτι δικαιω νομος ου κειται ανομοις δε και ανυποτακτοις ασεβεσιν και αμαρτωλοις ανοσιοις και βεβηλοις πατραλωαις και μητραλωαις ανδροφονοις
kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

vulg: fornicariis masculorum concubitoribus plagiariis mendacibus periuris et si quid aliud sanae doctrinae adversatur
clem: fornicariis, masculorum concubitoribus, plagiariis, mendacibus, et perjuris, et si quid aliud san doctrin adversatur,
tr: πορνοις αρσενοκοιταις ανδραποδισταις ψευσταις επιορκοις και ει τι ετερον τη υγιαινουση διδασκαλια αντικειται
kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

vulg: quae est secundum evangelium gloriae beati Dei quod creditum est mihi
clem: qu est secundum Evangelium glori beati Dei, quod creditum est mihi.
tr: κατα το ευαγγελιον της δοξης του μακαριου θεου ο επιστευθην εγω
kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

vulg: gratias ago ei qui me confortavit Christo Iesu Domino nostro quia fidelem me existimavit ponens in ministerio
clem: Gratias ago ei, qui me confortavit, Christo Jesu Domino nostro, quia fidelem me existimavit, ponens in ministerio:
tr: και χαριν εχω τω ενδυναμωσαντι με χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων οτι πιστον με ηγησατο θεμενος εις διακονιαν
kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

vulg: qui prius fui blasphemus et persecutor et contumeliosus sed misericordiam consecutus sum quia ignorans feci in incredulitate
clem: qui prius blasphemus fui, et persecutor, et contumeliosus: sed misericordiam Dei consecutus sum, quia ignorans feci in incredulitate.
tr: τον προτερον οντα βλασφημον και διωκτην και υβριστην αλλ ηλεηθην οτι αγνοων εποιησα εν απιστια
kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

vulg: superabundavit autem gratia Domini nostri cum fide et dilectione quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: Superabundavit autem gratia Domini nostri cum fide, et dilectione, qu est in Christo Jesu.
tr: υπερεπλεονασεν δε η χαρις του κυριου ημων μετα πιστεως και αγαπης της εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

vulg: fidelis sermo et omni acceptione dignus quia Christus Iesus venit in mundum peccatores salvos facere quorum primus ego sum
clem: Fidelis sermo, et omni acceptione dignus: quod Christus Jesus venit in hunc mundum peccatores salvos facere, quorum primus ego sum.
tr: πιστος ο λογος και πασης αποδοχης αξιος οτι χριστος ιησους ηλθεν εις τον κοσμον αμαρτωλους σωσαι ων πρωτος ειμι εγω
kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

vulg: sed ideo misericordiam consecutus sum ut in me primo ostenderet Christus Iesus omnem patientiam ad deformationem eorum qui credituri sunt illi in vitam aeternam
clem: Sed ideo misericordiam consecutus sum: ut in me primo ostenderet Christus Jesus omnem patientiam ad informationem eorum, qui credituri sunt illi, in vitam ternam.
tr: αλλα δια τουτο ηλεηθην ινα εν εμοι πρωτω ενδειξηται ιησους χριστος την πασαν μακροθυμιαν προς υποτυπωσιν των μελλοντων πιστευειν επ αυτω εις ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

vulg: regi autem saeculorum inmortali invisibili soli Deo honor et gloria in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: Regi autem sculorum immortali, invisibili, soli Deo honor et gloria in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: τω δε βασιλει των αιωνων αφθαρτω αορατω μονω σοφω θεω τιμη και δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: hoc praeceptum commendo tibi fili Timothee secundum praecedentes in te prophetias ut milites in illis bonam militiam
clem: Hoc prceptum commendo tibi, fili Timothee, secundum prcedentes in te prophetias, ut milites in illis bonam militiam,
tr: ταυτην την παραγγελιαν παρατιθεμαι σοι τεκνον τιμοθεε κατα τας προαγουσας επι σε προφητειας ινα στρατευη εν αυταις την καλην στρατειαν
kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

vulg: habens fidem et bonam conscientiam quam quidam repellentes circa fidem naufragaverunt
clem: habens fidem, et bonam conscientiam, quam quidam repellentes, circa fidem naufragaverunt:
tr: εχων πιστιν και αγαθην συνειδησιν ην τινες απωσαμενοι περι την πιστιν εναυαγησαν
kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

vulg: ex quibus est Hymeneus et Alexander quos tradidi Satanae ut discant non blasphemare
clem: ex quibus est Hymenus, et Alexander: quos tradidi Satan, ut discant non blasphemare.
tr: ων εστιν υμεναιος και αλεξανδρος ους παρεδωκα τω σατανα ινα παιδευθωσιν μη βλασφημειν
kjv: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

vulg: obsecro igitur primo omnium fieri obsecrationes orationes postulationes gratiarum actiones pro omnibus hominibus
clem: Obsecro igitur primum omnium fieri obsecrationes, orationes, postulationes, gratiarum actiones, pro omnibus hominibus:
tr: παρακαλω ουν πρωτον παντων ποιεισθαι δεησεις προσευχας εντευξεις ευχαριστιας υπερ παντων ανθρωπων
kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

vulg: pro regibus et omnibus qui in sublimitate sunt ut quietam et tranquillam vitam agamus in omni pietate et castitate
clem: pro regibus, et omnibus qui in sublimitate sunt, ut quietam et tranquillam vitam agamus in omni pietate, et castitate:
tr: υπερ βασιλεων και παντων των εν υπεροχη οντων ινα ηρεμον και ησυχιον βιον διαγωμεν εν παση ευσεβεια και σεμνοτητι
kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

vulg: hoc enim bonum est et acceptum coram salutari nostro Deo
clem: hoc enim bonum est, et acceptum coram Salvatore nostro Deo,
tr: τουτο γαρ καλον και αποδεκτον ενωπιον του σωτηρος ημων θεου
kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

vulg: qui omnes homines vult salvos fieri et ad agnitionem veritatis venire
clem: qui omnes homines vult salvos fieri, et ad agnitionem veritatis venire.
tr: ος παντας ανθρωπους θελει σωθηναι και εις επιγνωσιν αληθειας ελθειν
kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

vulg: unus enim Deus unus et mediator Dei et hominum homo Christus Iesus
clem: Unus enim Deus, unus et mediator Dei et hominum homo Christus Jesus:
tr: εις γαρ θεος εις και μεσιτης θεου και ανθρωπων ανθρωπος χριστος ιησους
kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

vulg: qui dedit redemptionem semet ipsum pro omnibus testimonium temporibus suis
clem: qui dedit redemptionem semetipsum pro omnibus, testimonium temporibus suis:
tr: ο δους εαυτον αντιλυτρον υπερ παντων το μαρτυριον καιροις ιδιοις
kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

vulg: in quo positus sum ego praedicator et apostolus veritatem dico non mentior doctor gentium in fide et veritate
clem: in quo positus sum ego prdicator, et Apostolus (veritatem dico, non mentior) doctor gentium in fide, et veritate.
tr: εις ο ετεθην εγω κηρυξ και αποστολος αληθειαν λεγω εν χριστω ου ψευδομαι διδασκαλος εθνων εν πιστει και αληθεια
kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

vulg: volo ergo viros orare in omni loco levantes puras manus sine ira et disceptatione
clem: Volo ergo viros orare in omni loco, levantes puras manus sine ira et disceptatione.
tr: βουλομαι ουν προσευχεσθαι τους ανδρας εν παντι τοπω επαιροντας οσιους χειρας χωρις οργης και διαλογισμου
kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

vulg: similiter et mulieres in habitu ornato cum verecundia et sobrietate ornantes se non in tortis crinibus aut auro aut margaritis vel veste pretiosa
clem: Similiter et mulieres in habitu ornato, cum verecundia et sobrietate ornantes se, et non in tortis crinibus, aut auro, aut margaritas, vel veste pretiosa:
tr: ωσαυτως και τας γυναικας εν καταστολη κοσμιω μετα αιδους και σωφροσυνης κοσμειν εαυτας μη εν πλεγμασιν η χρυσω η μαργαριταις η ιματισμω πολυτελει
kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

vulg: sed quod decet mulieres promittentes pietatem per opera bona
clem: sed quod decet mulieres, promittentes pietatem per opera bona.
tr: αλλ ο πρεπει γυναιξιν επαγγελλομεναις θεοσεβειαν δι εργων αγαθων
kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

vulg: mulier in silentio discat cum omni subiectione
clem: Mulier in silentio discat cum omni subjectione.
tr: γυνη εν ησυχια μανθανετω εν παση υποταγη
kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

vulg: docere autem mulieri non permitto neque dominari in virum sed esse in silentio
clem: Docere autem mulierem non permitto, neque dominari in virum: sed esse in silentio.
tr: γυναικι δε διδασκειν ουκ επιτρεπω ουδε αυθεντειν ανδρος αλλ ειναι εν ησυχια
kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

vulg: Adam enim primus formatus est deinde Eva
clem: Adam enim primus formatus est: deinde Heva:
tr: αδαμ γαρ πρωτος επλασθη ειτα ευα
kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

vulg: et Adam non est seductus mulier autem seducta in praevaricatione fuit
clem: et Adam non est seductus: mulier autem seducta in prvaricatione fuit.
tr: και αδαμ ουκ ηπατηθη η δε γυνη απατηθεισα εν παραβασει γεγονεν
kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

vulg: salvabitur autem per filiorum generationem si permanserint in fide et dilectione et sanctificatione cum sobrietate
clem: Salvabitur autem per filiorum generationem, si permanserit in fide, et dilectione, et sanctificatione cum sobrietate.
tr: σωθησεται δε δια της τεκνογονιας εαν μεινωσιν εν πιστει και αγαπη και αγιασμω μετα σωφροσυνης
kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

vulg: fidelis sermo si quis episcopatum desiderat bonum opus desiderat
clem: Fidelis sermo: si quis episcopatum desiderat, bonum opus desiderat.
tr: πιστος ο λογος ει τις επισκοπης ορεγεται καλου εργου επιθυμει
kjv: This is a true saying, if a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

vulg: oportet ergo episcopum inreprehensibilem esse unius uxoris virum sobrium prudentem ornatum hospitalem doctorem
clem: Oportet ergo episcopum irreprehensibilem esse, unius uxoris virum, sobrium, prudentem, ornatum, pudicum, hospitalem, doctorem,
tr: δει ουν τον επισκοπον ανεπιληπτον ειναι μιας γυναικος ανδρα νηφαλεον  νηφαλιον   σωφρονα κοσμιον φιλοξενον διδακτικον
kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

vulg: non vinolentum non percussorem sed modestum non litigiosum non cupidum
clem: non vinolentum, non percussorem, sed modestum: non litigiosum, non cupidum, sed
tr: μη παροινον μη πληκτην μη αισχροκερδη αλλ επιεικη αμαχον αφιλαργυρον
kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

vulg: suae domui bene praepositum filios habentem subditos cum omni castitate
clem: su domui bene prpositum: filios habentem subditos cum omni castitate.
tr: του ιδιου οικου καλως προισταμενον τεκνα εχοντα εν υποταγη μετα πασης σεμνοτητος
kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

vulg: si quis autem domui suae praeesse nescit quomodo ecclesiae Dei diligentiam habebit
clem: Si quis autem domui su presse nescit, quomodo ecclesi Dei diligentiam habebit?
tr: ει δε τις του ιδιου οικου προστηναι ουκ οιδεν πως εκκλησιας θεου επιμελησεται
kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

vulg: non neophytum ne in superbia elatus in iudicium incidat diaboli
clem: Non neophytum: ne in superbiam elatus, in judicium incidat diaboli.
tr: μη νεοφυτον ινα μη τυφωθεις εις κριμα εμπεση του διαβολου
kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

vulg: oportet autem illum et testimonium habere bonum ab his qui foris sunt ut non in obprobrium incidat et laqueum diaboli
clem: Oportet autem illum et testimonium habere bonum ab iis qui foris sunt, ut non in opprobrium incidat, et in laqueum diaboli.
tr: δει δε αυτον και μαρτυριαν καλην εχειν απο των εξωθεν ινα μη εις ονειδισμον εμπεση και παγιδα του διαβολου
kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

vulg: diaconos similiter pudicos non bilingues non multo vino deditos non turpe lucrum sectantes
clem: Diaconos similiter pudicos, non bilingues, non multo vino deditos, non turpe lucrum sectantes:
tr: διακονους ωσαυτως σεμνους μη διλογους μη οινω πολλω προσεχοντας μη αισχροκερδεις
kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

vulg: habentes mysterium fidei in conscientia pura
clem: habentes mysterium fidei in conscientia pura.
tr: εχοντας το μυστηριον της πιστεως εν καθαρα συνειδησει
kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

vulg: et hii autem probentur primum et sic ministrent nullum crimen habentes
clem: Et hi autem probentur primum: et sic ministrent, nullum crimen habentes.
tr: και ουτοι δε δοκιμαζεσθωσαν πρωτον ειτα διακονειτωσαν ανεγκλητοι οντες
kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

vulg: mulieres similiter pudicas non detrahentes sobrias fideles in omnibus
clem: Mulieres similiter pudicas, non detrahentes, sobrias, fideles in omnibus.
tr: γυναικας ωσαυτως σεμνας μη διαβολους νηφαλεους  νηφαλιους   πιστας εν πασιν
kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

vulg: diacones sint unius uxoris viri qui filiis suis bene praesunt et suis domibus
clem: Diaconi sint unius uxoris viri, qui filiis suis bene prsint, et suis domibus.
tr: διακονοι εστωσαν μιας γυναικος ανδρες τεκνων καλως προισταμενοι και των ιδιων οικων
kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

vulg: qui enim bene ministraverint gradum sibi bonum adquirent et multam fiduciam in fide quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: Qui enim bene ministraverint, gradum bonum sibi acquirent, et multam fiduciam in fide, qu est in Christo Jesu.
tr: οι γαρ καλως διακονησαντες βαθμον εαυτοις καλον περιποιουνται και πολλην παρρησιαν εν πιστει τη εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

vulg: haec tibi scribo sperans venire ad te cito
clem: Hc tibi scribo, sperans me ad te venire cito:
tr: ταυτα σοι γραφω ελπιζων ελθειν προς σε ταχιον
kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

vulg: si autem tardavero ut scias quomodo oporteat te in domo Dei conversari quae est ecclesia Dei vivi columna et firmamentum veritatis
clem: si autem tardavero, ut scias quomodo oporteat te in domo Dei conversari, qu est ecclesia Dei vivi, columna et firmamentum veritatis.
tr: εαν δε βραδυνω ινα ειδης πως δει εν οικω θεου αναστρεφεσθαι ητις εστιν εκκλησια θεου ζωντος στυλος και εδραιωμα της αληθειας
kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

vulg: et manifeste magnum est pietatis sacramentum quod manifestatum est in carne iustificatum est in spiritu apparuit angelis praedicatum est gentibus creditum est in mundo adsumptum est in gloria
clem: Et manifeste magnum est pietatis sacramentum, quod manifestatum est in carne, justificatum est in spiritu, apparuit angelis, prdicatum est gentibus, creditum est in mundo, assumptum est in gloria.
tr: και ομολογουμενως μεγα εστιν το της ευσεβειας μυστηριον θεος εφανερωθη εν σαρκι εδικαιωθη εν πνευματι ωφθη αγγελοις εκηρυχθη εν εθνεσιν επιστευθη εν κοσμω ανεληφθη εν δοξη
kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

vulg: Spiritus autem manifeste dicit quia in novissimis temporibus discedent quidam a fide adtendentes spiritibus erroris et doctrinis daemoniorum
clem: Spiritus autem manifeste dicit, quia in novissimis temporibus discedent quidam a fide, attendentes spiritibus erroris, et doctrinis dmoniorum,
tr: το δε πνευμα ρητως λεγει οτι εν υστεροις καιροις αποστησονται τινες της πιστεως προσεχοντες πνευμασιν πλανοις και διδασκαλιαις δαιμονιων
kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

vulg: in hypocrisi loquentium mendacium et cauteriatam habentium suam conscientiam
clem: in hypocrisi loquentium mendacium, et cauteriatam habentium suam conscientiam,
tr: εν υποκρισει ψευδολογων κεκαυτηριασμενων την ιδιαν συνειδησιν
kjv: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

vulg: prohibentium nubere abstinere a cibis quos Deus creavit ad percipiendum cum gratiarum actione fidelibus et his qui cognoverunt veritatem
clem: prohibentium nubere, abstinere a cibis, quod Deus creavit ad percipiendum cum gratiarum actione fidelibus, et iis qui cognoverunt veritatem.
tr: κωλυοντων γαμειν απεχεσθαι βρωματων α ο θεος εκτισεν εις μεταληψιν μετα ευχαριστιας τοις πιστοις και επεγνωκοσιν την αληθειαν
kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

vulg: quia omnis creatura Dei bona et nihil reiciendum quod cum gratiarum actione percipitur
clem: Quia omnis creatura Dei bona est, et nihil rejiciendum quod cum gratiarum actione percipitur:
tr: οτι παν κτισμα θεου καλον και ουδεν αποβλητον μετα ευχαριστιας λαμβανομενον
kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

vulg: sanctificatur enim per verbum Dei et orationem
clem: sanctificatur enim per verbum Dei, et orationem.
tr: αγιαζεται γαρ δια λογου θεου και εντευξεως
kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

vulg: haec proponens fratribus bonus eris minister Christi Iesu enutritus verbis fidei et bonae doctrinae quam adsecutus es
clem: Hc proponens fratribus, bonus eris minister Christi Jesu enutritus verbis fidei, et bon doctrin, quam assecutus es.
tr: ταυτα υποτιθεμενος τοις αδελφοις καλος εση διακονος ιησου χριστου εντρεφομενος τοις λογοις της πιστεως και της καλης διδασκαλιας η παρηκολουθηκας
kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

vulg: ineptas autem et aniles fabulas devita exerce te ipsum ad pietatem
clem: Ineptas autem, et aniles fabulas devita: exerce autem teipsum ad pietatem.
tr: τους δε βεβηλους και γραωδεις μυθους παραιτου γυμναζε δε σεαυτον προς ευσεβειαν
kjv: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

vulg: nam corporalis exercitatio ad modicum utilis est pietas autem ad omnia utilis est promissionem habens vitae quae nunc est et futurae
clem: Nam corporalis exercitatio, ad modicum utilis est: pietas autem ad omnia utilis est, promissionem habens vit, qu nunc est, et futur.
tr: η γαρ σωματικη γυμνασια προς ολιγον εστιν ωφελιμος η δε ευσεβεια προς παντα ωφελιμος εστιν επαγγελιαν εχουσα ζωης της νυν και της μελλουσης
kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

vulg: fidelis sermo et omni acceptione dignus
clem: Fidelis sermo, et omni acceptione dignus.
tr: πιστος ο λογος και πασης αποδοχης αξιος
kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

vulg: in hoc enim laboramus et maledicimur quia speravimus in Deum vivum qui est salvator omnium hominum maxime fidelium
clem: In hoc enim laboramus, et maledicimur, quia speramus in Deum vivum, qui est Salvator omnium hominum, maxime fidelium.
tr: εις τουτο γαρ και κοπιωμεν και ονειδιζομεθα οτι ηλπικαμεν επι θεω ζωντι ος εστιν σωτηρ παντων ανθρωπων μαλιστα πιστων
kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

vulg: praecipe haec et doce
clem: Prcipe hc, et doce.
tr: παραγγελλε ταυτα και διδασκε
kjv: These things command and teach.

vulg: nemo adulescentiam tuam contemnat sed exemplum esto fidelium in verbo in conversatione in caritate in fide in castitate
clem: Nemo adolescentiam tuam contemnat: sed exemplum esto fidelium in verbo, in conversatione, in caritate, in fide, in castitate.
tr: μηδεις σου της νεοτητος καταφρονειτω αλλα τυπος γινου των πιστων εν λογω εν αναστροφη εν αγαπη εν πνευματι εν πιστει εν αγνεια
kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

vulg: dum venio adtende lectioni exhortationi doctrinae
clem: Dum venio, attende lectioni, exhortationi, et doctrin.
tr: εως ερχομαι προσεχε τη αναγνωσει τη παρακλησει τη διδασκαλια
kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

vulg: noli neglegere gratiam quae in te est quae data est tibi per prophetiam cum inpositione manuum presbyterii
clem: Noli negligere gratiam, qu in te est, qu data est tibi per prophetiam, cum impositione manuum presbyterii.
tr: μη αμελει του εν σοι χαρισματος ο εδοθη σοι δια προφητειας μετα επιθεσεως των χειρων του πρεσβυτεριου
kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

vulg: haec meditare in his esto ut profectus tuus manifestus sit omnibus
clem: Hc meditare, in his esto: ut profectus tuus manifestus sit omnibus.
tr: ταυτα μελετα εν τουτοις ισθι ινα σου η προκοπη φανερα η εν πασιν
kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

vulg: adtende tibi et doctrinae insta in illis hoc enim faciens et te ipsum salvum facies et qui te audiunt
clem: Attende tibi, et doctrin: insta in illis. Hoc enim faciens, et teipsum salvum facies, et eos qui te audiunt.
tr: επεχε σεαυτω και τη διδασκαλια επιμενε αυτοις τουτο γαρ ποιων και σεαυτον σωσεις και τους ακουοντας σου
kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

vulg: seniorem ne increpaveris sed obsecra ut patrem iuvenes ut fratres
clem: Seniorem ne increpaveris, sed obsecra ut patrem: juvenes, ut fratres:
tr: πρεσβυτερω μη επιπληξης αλλα παρακαλει ως πατερα νεωτερους ως αδελφους
kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

vulg: anus ut matres iuvenculas ut sorores in omni castitate
clem: anus, ut matres: juvenculas, ut sorores in omni castitate:
tr: πρεσβυτερας ως μητερας νεωτερας ως αδελφας εν παση αγνεια
kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

vulg: viduas honora quae vere viduae sunt
clem: viduas honora, qu vere vidu sunt.
tr: χηρας τιμα τας οντως χηρας
kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

vulg: si qua autem vidua filios aut nepotes habet discant primum domum suam regere et mutuam vicem reddere parentibus hoc enim acceptum est coram Deo
clem: Si qua autem vidua filios, aut nepotes habet: discat primum domum suam regere, et mutuam vicem reddere parentibus: hoc enim acceptum est coram Deo.
tr: ει δε τις χηρα τεκνα η εκγονα εχει μανθανετωσαν πρωτον τον ιδιον οικον ευσεβειν και αμοιβας αποδιδοναι τοις προγονοις τουτο γαρ εστιν καλον και αποδεκτον ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

vulg: quae autem vere vidua est et desolata speravit in Deum et instat obsecrationibus et orationibus nocte ac die
clem: Qu autem vere vidua est, et desolata, speret in Deum, et instet obsecrationibus, et orationibus nocte ac die.
tr: η δε οντως χηρα και μεμονωμενη ηλπικεν επι τον θεον και προσμενει ταις δεησεσιν και ταις προσευχαις νυκτος και ημερας
kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

vulg: nam quae in deliciis est vivens mortua est
clem: Nam qu in deliciis est, vivens mortua est.
tr: η δε σπαταλωσα ζωσα τεθνηκεν
kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

vulg: et hoc praecipe ut inreprehensibiles sint
clem: Et hoc prcipe, ut irreprehensibiles sint.
tr: και ταυτα παραγγελλε ινα ανεπιληπτοι ωσιν
kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

vulg: si quis autem suorum et maxime domesticorum curam non habet fidem negavit et est infideli deterior
clem: Si quis autem suorum, et maxime domesticorum, curam non habet, fidem negavit, et est infideli deterior.
tr: ει δε τις των ιδιων και μαλιστα των οικειων ου προνοει την πιστιν ηρνηται και εστιν απιστου χειρων
kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

vulg: vidua eligatur non minus sexaginta annorum quae fuerit unius viri uxor
clem: Vidua eligatur non minus sexaginta annorum, qu fuerit unius viri uxor,
tr: χηρα καταλεγεσθω μη ελαττον ετων εξηκοντα γεγονυια ενος ανδρος γυνη
kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.

vulg: in operibus bonis testimonium habens si filios educavit si hospitio recepit si sanctorum pedes lavit si tribulationem patientibus subministravit si omne opus bonum subsecuta est
clem: in operibus bonis testimonium habens, si filios educavit, si hospitio recepit, si sanctorum pedes lavit, si tribulationem patientibus subministravit, si omne opus bonum subsecuta est.
tr: εν εργοις καλοις μαρτυρουμενη ει ετεκνοτροφησεν ει εξενοδοχησεν ει αγιων ποδας ενιψεν ει θλιβομενοις επηρκεσεν ει παντι εργω αγαθω επηκολουθησεν
kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

vulg: adulescentiores autem viduas devita cum enim luxuriatae fuerint in Christo nubere volunt
clem: Adolescentiores autem viduas devita: cum enim luxuriat fuerint in Christo, nubere volunt:
tr: νεωτερας δε χηρας παραιτου οταν γαρ καταστρηνιασωσιν του χριστου γαμειν θελουσιν
kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

vulg: habentes damnationem quia primam fidem irritam fecerunt
clem: habentes damnationem, quia primam fidem irritam fecerunt;
tr: εχουσαι κριμα οτι την πρωτην πιστιν ηθετησαν
kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

vulg: simul autem et otiosae discunt circumire domos non solum otiosae sed et verbosae et curiosae loquentes quae non oportet
clem: simul autem et otios discunt circuire domos: non solum otios, sed et verbos, et curios, loquentes qu non oportet.
tr: αμα δε και αργαι μανθανουσιν περιερχομεναι τας οικιας ου μονον δε αργαι αλλα και φλυαροι και περιεργοι λαλουσαι τα μη δεοντα
kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

vulg: volo ergo iuveniores nubere filios procreare matres familias esse nullam occasionem dare adversario maledicti gratia
clem: Volo ergo juniores nubere, filios procreare, matresfamilias esse, nullam occasionem dare adversario maledicti gratia.
tr: βουλομαι ουν νεωτερας γαμειν τεκνογονειν οικοδεσποτειν μηδεμιαν αφορμην διδοναι τω αντικειμενω λοιδοριας χαριν
kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

vulg: iam enim quaedam conversae sunt retro Satanan
clem: Jam enim qudam convers sunt retro Satanam.
tr: ηδη γαρ τινες εξετραπησαν οπισω του σατανα
kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

vulg: si qua fidelis habet viduas subministret illis et non gravetur ecclesia ut his quae vere viduae sunt sufficiat
clem: Si quis fidelis habet viduas, subministret illis, et non gravetur ecclesia: ut iis qu vere vidu sunt, sufficiat.
tr: ει τις πιστος η πιστη εχει χηρας επαρκειτω αυταις και μη βαρεισθω η εκκλησια ινα ταις οντως χηραις επαρκεση
kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

vulg: qui bene praesunt presbyteri duplici honore digni habeantur maxime qui laborant in verbo et doctrina
clem: Qui bene prsunt presbyteri, duplici honore digni habeantur: maxime qui laborant in verbo et doctrina.
tr: οι καλως προεστωτες πρεσβυτεροι διπλης τιμης αξιουσθωσαν μαλιστα οι κοπιωντες εν λογω και διδασκαλια
kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

vulg: dicit enim scriptura non infrenabis os bovi trituranti et dignus operarius mercede sua
clem: Dicit enim Scriptura: Non alligabis os bovi trituranti. Et: Dignus est operarius mercede sua.
tr: λεγει γαρ η γραφη βουν αλοωντα ου φιμωσεις και αξιος ο εργατης του μισθου αυτου
kjv: For the scripture saith, thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

vulg: adversus presbyterum accusationem noli recipere nisi sub duobus et tribus testibus
clem: Adversus presbyterum accusationem noli recipere, nisi sub duobus aut tribus testibus.
tr: κατα πρεσβυτερου κατηγοριαν μη παραδεχου εκτος ει μη επι δυο η τριων μαρτυρων
kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

vulg: peccantes coram omnibus argue ut et ceteri timorem habeant
clem: Peccantes coram omnibus argue: ut et ceteri timorem habeant.
tr: τους αμαρτανοντας ενωπιον παντων ελεγχε ινα και οι λοιποι φοβον εχωσιν
kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

vulg: testor coram Deo et Christo Iesu et electis angelis ut haec custodias sine praeiudicio nihil faciens in aliam partem declinando
clem: Testor coram Deo et Christo Jesu, et electis angelis, ut hc custodias sine prjudicio, nihil faciens in alteram partem declinando.
tr: διαμαρτυρομαι ενωπιον του θεου και κυριου ιησου χριστου και των εκλεκτων αγγελων ινα ταυτα φυλαξης χωρις προκριματος μηδεν ποιων κατα προσκλισιν
kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

vulg: manus cito nemini inposueris neque communicaveris peccatis alienis te ipsum castum custodi
clem: Manus cito nemini imposueris, neque communicaveris peccatis alienis. Teipsum castum custodi.
tr: χειρας ταχεως μηδενι επιτιθει μηδε κοινωνει αμαρτιαις αλλοτριαις σεαυτον αγνον τηρει
kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

vulg: noli adhuc aquam bibere sed vino modico utere propter stomachum tuum et frequentes tuas infirmitates
clem: Noli adhuc aquam bibere, sed modico vino utere propter stomachum tuum, et frequentes tuas infirmitates.
tr: μηκετι υδροποτει αλλ οινω ολιγω χρω δια τον στομαχον σου και τας πυκνας σου ασθενειας
kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

vulg: quorundam hominum peccata manifesta sunt praecedentia ad iudicium quosdam autem et subsequuntur
clem: Quorumdam hominum peccata manifesta sunt, prcedentia ad judicium: quosdam autem et subsequuntur.
tr: τινων ανθρωπων αι αμαρτιαι προδηλοι εισιν προαγουσαι εις κρισιν τισιν δε και επακολουθουσιν
kjv: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

vulg: similiter et facta bona manifesta sunt et quae aliter se habent abscondi non possunt
clem: Similiter et facta bona, manifesta sunt: et qu aliter se habent, abscondi non possunt.
tr: ωσαυτως και τα καλα εργα προδηλα εστιν και τα αλλως εχοντα κρυβηναι ου δυναται
kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

vulg: quicumque sunt sub iugo servi dominos suos omni honore dignos arbitrentur ne nomen Domini et doctrina blasphemetur
clem: Quicumque sunt sub jugo servi, dominos suos omni honore dignos arbitrentur, ne nomen Domini et doctrina blasphemetur.
tr: οσοι εισιν υπο ζυγον δουλοι τους ιδιους δεσποτας πασης τιμης αξιους ηγεισθωσαν ινα μη το ονομα του θεου και η διδασκαλια βλασφημηται
kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

vulg: qui autem fideles habent dominos non contemnant quia fratres sunt sed magis serviant quia fideles sunt et dilecti qui beneficii participes sunt haec doce et exhortare
clem: Qui autem fideles habent dominos, non contemnant, quia fratres sunt: sed magis serviant, quia fideles sunt et dilecti, qui beneficii participes sunt. Hc doce, et exhortare.
tr: οι δε πιστους εχοντες δεσποτας μη καταφρονειτωσαν οτι αδελφοι εισιν αλλα μαλλον δουλευετωσαν οτι πιστοι εισιν και αγαπητοι οι της ευεργεσιας αντιλαμβανομενοι ταυτα διδασκε και παρακαλει
kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

vulg: si quis aliter docet et non adquiescit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri Iesu Christi et ei quae secundum pietatem est doctrinae
clem: Si quis aliter docet, et non acquiescit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri Jesu Christi, et ei, qu secundum pietatem est, doctrin:
tr: ει τις ετεροδιδασκαλει και μη προσερχεται υγιαινουσιν λογοις τοις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου και τη κατ ευσεβειαν διδασκαλια
kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

vulg: superbus nihil sciens sed languens circa quaestiones et pugnas verborum ex quibus oriuntur invidiae contentiones blasphemiae suspiciones malae
clem: superbus est, nihil sciens, sed languens circa qustiones, et pugnas verborum: ex quibus oriuntur invidi, contentiones, blasphemi, suspiciones mal,
tr: τετυφωται μηδεν επισταμενος αλλα νοσων περι ζητησεις και λογομαχιας εξ ων γινεται φθονος ερις βλασφημιαι υπονοιαι πονηραι
kjv: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

vulg: conflictationes hominum mente corruptorum et qui veritate privati sunt existimantium quaestum esse pietatem
clem: conflictationes hominum mente corruptorum, et qui veritate privati sunt, existimantium qustum esse pietatem.
tr: παραδιατριβαι διεφθαρμενων ανθρωπων τον νουν και απεστερημενων της αληθειας νομιζοντων πορισμον ειναι την ευσεβειαν αφιστασο απο των τοιουτων
kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

vulg: est autem quaestus magnus pietas cum sufficientia
clem: Est autem qustus magnus pietas cum sufficentia.
tr: εστιν δε πορισμος μεγας η ευσεβεια μετα αυταρκειας
kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

vulg: nihil enim intulimus in mundum haut dubium quia nec auferre quid possumus
clem: Nihil enim intulimus in hunc mundum: haud dubium quod nec auferre quid possumus.
tr: ουδεν γαρ εισηνεγκαμεν εις τον κοσμον δηλον οτι ουδε εξενεγκειν τι δυναμεθα
kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

vulg: habentes autem alimenta et quibus tegamur his contenti sumus
clem: Habentes autem alimenta, et quibus tegamur, his contenti simus.
tr: εχοντες δε διατροφας και σκεπασματα τουτοις αρκεσθησομεθα
kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

vulg: nam qui volunt divites fieri incidunt in temptationem et laqueum et desideria multa inutilia et nociva quae mergunt homines in interitum et perditionem
clem: Nam qui volunt divites fieri, incidunt in tentationem, et in laqueum diaboli, et desideria multa inutilia, et nociva, qu mergunt homines in interitum et perditionem.
tr: οι δε βουλομενοι πλουτειν εμπιπτουσιν εις πειρασμον και παγιδα και επιθυμιας πολλας ανοητους και βλαβερας αιτινες βυθιζουσιν τους ανθρωπους εις ολεθρον και απωλειαν
kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

vulg: radix enim omnium malorum est cupiditas quam quidam appetentes erraverunt a fide et inseruerunt se doloribus multis
clem: Radix enim omnium malorum est cupiditas: quam quidam appetentes erraverunt a fide, et inseruerunt se doloribus malis.
tr: ριζα γαρ παντων των κακων εστιν η φιλαργυρια ης τινες ορεγομενοι απεπλανηθησαν απο της πιστεως και εαυτους περιεπειραν οδυναις πολλαις
kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

vulg: tu autem o homo Dei haec fuge sectare vero iustitiam pietatem fidem caritatem patientiam mansuetudinem
clem: Tu autem, o homo Dei, hc fuge: sectare vero justitiam, pietatem, fidem, caritatem, patientiam, mansuetudinem.
tr: συ δε ω ανθρωπε του θεου ταυτα φευγε διωκε δε δικαιοσυνην ευσεβειαν πιστιν αγαπην υπομονην πραοτητα
kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

vulg: certa bonum certamen fidei adprehende vitam aeternam in qua vocatus es et confessus bonam confessionem coram multis testibus
clem: Certa bonum certamen fidei, apprehende vitam ternam, in qua vocatus es, et confessus bonam confessionem coram multis testibus.
tr: αγωνιζου τον καλον αγωνα της πιστεως επιλαβου της αιωνιου ζωης εις ην και εκληθης και ωμολογησας την καλην ομολογιαν ενωπιον πολλων μαρτυρων
kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

vulg: praecipio tibi coram Deo qui vivificat omnia et Christo Iesu qui testimonium reddidit sub Pontio Pilato bonam confessionem
clem: Prcipio tibi coram Deo, qui vivificat omnia, et Christo Jesu, qui testimonium reddidit sub Pontio Pilato, bonam confessionem,
tr: παραγγελλω σοι ενωπιον του θεου του ζωοποιουντος τα παντα και χριστου ιησου του μαρτυρησαντος επι ποντιου πιλατου την καλην ομολογιαν
kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

vulg: ut serves mandatum sine macula inreprehensibile usque in adventum Domini nostri Iesu Christi
clem: ut serves mandatum sine macula, irreprehensibile usque in adventum Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
tr: τηρησαι σε την εντολην ασπιλον ανεπιληπτον μεχρι της επιφανειας του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

vulg: quem suis temporibus ostendet beatus et solus potens rex regum et Dominus dominantium
clem: quem suis temporibus ostendet beatus et solus potens, Rex regum, et Dominus dominantium:
tr: ην καιροις ιδιοις δειξει ο μακαριος και μονος δυναστης ο βασιλευς των βασιλευοντων και κυριος των κυριευοντων
kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

vulg: qui solus habet inmortalitatem lucem habitans inaccessibilem quem vidit nullus hominum sed nec videre potest cui honor et imperium sempiternum amen
clem: qui solus habet immortalitatem, et lucem inhabitat inaccessibilem: quem nullus hominum vidit, sed nec videre potest: cui honor, et imperium sempiternum. Amen.
tr: ο μονος εχων αθανασιαν φως οικων απροσιτον ον ειδεν ουδεις ανθρωπων ουδε ιδειν δυναται ω τιμη και κρατος αιωνιον αμην
kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

vulg: divitibus huius saeculi praecipe non sublime sapere neque sperare in incerto divitiarum sed in Deo qui praestat nobis omnia abunde ad fruendum
clem: Divitibus hujus sculi prcipe non sublime sapere, neque sperare in incerto divitiarum, sed in Deo vivo (qui prstat nobis omnia abunde ad fruendum)
tr: τοις πλουσιοις εν τω νυν αιωνι παραγγελλε μη υψηλοφρονειν μηδε ηλπικεναι επι πλουτου αδηλοτητι αλλ εν τω θεω τω ζωντι τω παρεχοντι ημιν πλουσιως παντα εις απολαυσιν
kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

vulg: bene agere divites fieri in operibus bonis facile tribuere communicare
clem: bene agere, divites fieri in bonis operibus, facile tribuere, communicare,
tr: αγαθοεργειν πλουτειν εν εργοις καλοις ευμεταδοτους ειναι κοινωνικους
kjv: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

vulg: thesaurizare sibi fundamentum bonum in futurum ut adprehendant veram vitam
clem: thesaurizare sibi fundamentum bonum in futurum, ut apprehendant veram vitam.
tr: αποθησαυριζοντας εαυτοις θεμελιον καλον εις το μελλον ινα επιλαβωνται της αιωνιου ζωης
kjv: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

vulg: o Timothee depositum custodi devitans profanas vocum novitates et oppositiones falsi nominis scientiae
clem: O Timothee, depositum custodi, devitans profanas vocum novitates, et oppositiones falsi nominis scienti,
tr: ω τιμοθεε την παρακαταθηκην φυλαξον εκτρεπομενος τας βεβηλους κενοφωνιας και αντιθεσεις της ψευδωνυμου γνωσεως
kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

vulg: quam quidam promittentes circa fidem exciderunt gratia tecum
clem: quam quidam promittentes, circa fidem exciderunt. Gratia tecum. Amen.
tr: ην τινες επαγγελλομενοι περι την πιστιν ηστοχησαν η χαρις μετα σου αμην [ προς τιμοθεον πρωτη εγραφη απο λαοδικειας ητις εστιν μητροπολις φρυγιας της πακατιανης]
kjv: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
